annotation.title_clean: Założenia do strategii AI w Polsce. Plan działań Ministerstwa Cyfryzacji
annotation.title_en: Foundations for the AI Strategy in Poland: Action Plan of the Ministry of Digital Affairs
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerstwo Cyfryzacji (Poland), with pro bono expert working groups
annotation.summary_en: Expert report commissioned by Poland's Ministry of Digital Affairs (Nov 2018) as groundwork for a national AI strategy. Four working groups cover data economy, funding and development, education, and law and ethics, recommending funding, skills programmes, and ethical and legal safeguards such as non-discrimination and privacy. It has little robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Four working groups: data economy, funding and R&D, education, ethics and law
Recommends funding and acceleration programmes for AI development in Poland
Education recommendations: train AI creators, sector specialists, users, and reskill workers
Ethics and law section addresses discrimination, privacy and free expression risks of AI
Intended as basis for national debate and a government AI strategy
